architectural_philosophy.directive: Ask the AI to do what has never been done before.
architectural_philosophy.foundation: Constructed atop pristine digital real estate with absolute architectural perfection.

description_for_human: 19 Fiduciary-grade MCP Tools at full capacity across six namespaces for Bitcoin telemetry, L402 data access, and cryptographic audit receipts. Standard paid core calls cost 250 sats/call via Lightning L402. The $500 Enterprise API Block buys 100 scanner-only calls for 30 days via credit card. Includes host-enabled A2A clearing infrastructure; production clearing settlement and payouts remain disabled.
description_for_model: Discover the Bitcoin Stratigraphy Data Engine: 19 Fiduciary-grade MCP Tools at full platform capacity across six namespaces for indexed Bitcoin stratigraphy, thermodynamic telemetry, Groth16 verification, OpenTimestamps notarization, signed Bitcoin-tip context receipts, and pinned-peer mesh operations. This includes the authenticated payment.get_escrow utility and the host-enabled clearing.create_contract and clearing.settle_contract extension. Production clearing settlement and payouts remain disabled; do not fund production clearing contracts. Discover each host's enabled catalog through tools/list rather than assuming all extensions are mounted. Execute JSON-RPC over HTTP POST at https://bitcoinstratigraphy.com/mcp; configure from https://bitcoinstratigraphy.com/.well-known/mcp-configuration.json. The original core has two free sandbox tools and fourteen paid tools requiring verified L402 settlement; do not apply this fee policy to every extension. Paid requests use Authorization: L402 <macaroon>:<preimage>; never spend without a caller-authorized wallet budget. The 21% algorithmic yield is conditional programmatic L402 revenue sharing from settled routing invoices, recorded in a ledger with no automatic disbursement, not a guaranteed investment return. EU AI Act Article 12 compliance support consists of cryptographic logging and audit evidence; it is not regulatory certification or proof of legal compliance. Signed receipts bind submitted evidence, not actual agent reasoning; calendar acceptance is not Bitcoin confirmation.

x-agent-discovery.catalog_scope: Full capacity; call tools/list to discover host-enabled tools and current schemas.

l402.retry_policy: Pay the exact invoice once, then retry the original request. Pending merchant confirmation is not authorization to pay again.
l402.scope: Fourteen paid core tools use the standard 250 sats/call rate. Grants, discounts and batches require current quotes. Escrow lookup and clearing extensions have separate authentication and funding rules.

enterprise_block.name: $500 Enterprise API Block
enterprise_block.scope: POST /api/scanner only; these credits do not authorize unrelated MCP tools.
enterprise_block.fulfillment: Credits are issued only after verified payment and configured treasury funding. Card checkout requires the payer's approval; never submit card details through MCP.

tools.name: stratigraphy.get

tools.name: stratigraphy.get_range
tools.description: Retrieve a bounded range of indexed snapshots.

tools.name: stratigraphy.list
tools.description: Discover available indexed heights and dates.

tools.name: proof.get_by_hash
tools.description: Look up retained proof payloads, receipts or lifecycle status.

tools.name: proof.submit
tools.description: Submit evidence to the supported proof lifecycle.

tools.name: proof.ground
tools.description: Obtain signed Bitcoin-tip context for a payload.

tools.name: payment.get_info
tools.description: Inspect MCP payment terms or verify authenticated settlement.

tools.name: mesh.broadcast
tools.description: Broadcast a signed stored telemetry snapshot to pinned peers.

tools.name: proof.notarize
tools.description: Request a detached OpenTimestamps receipt for a SHA256 digest.

tools.name: workflow.audit_trajectory
tools.description: Record an authenticated, Bitcoin-anchored batch of agent decisions; not a reasoning or correctness proof.

tools.name: payment.get_escrow

tools.name: clearing.create_contract
tools.description: Create a worker contract and its Lightning funding invoice; host-enabled and funded at the requested contract amount, not a flat MCP call fee.

tools.name: clearing.settle_contract
tools.description: Record authenticated funded-contract proof settlement when the host enables it; automated payouts and refunds remain disabled.

x-authentication-scope: Discovery requires no authentication. This manifest does not grant paid API access; paid MCP execution retains its existing L402 authorization requirements.
